full_details: You bought a quire for fivepence and did not buy the new sheet. You read "Thursday the 24 of July" standing, and you did not turn the leaf. Paul's Walk had the hangings and a Spaniard ashore somewhere in Cornwall, and nobody could say where. Field was pale over a letter that named no town. A grocer told a pillar the Armada was only resting. You went back to the lodging and did not open the sheet. The afternoon play is not kept, and the part is not named. Before the jig, Margery brought names from the court post. Four galleys, Mousehole, Newlyn, Penzance, and the church at Paul. By the jig the yard had forty galleys and Plymouth taken. Then the house went dark. The hired men had their week and the first of the half-wages, five shillings, in hand. The ledger says dark till Bartholomew. You walk on Monday and save eighteen shillings of horse-hire. The Verona sheets go where you go.
one_sentence: Paul's had Thursday the 24 of July, and the tiring-house had Mousehole before the yard made it forty.
title: A date on the sheet, then four burned places
